notes:
What's new in 0.9.226 (beta)
- SMART only says numbers GOAT measured: every time and gap in a call comes from your laps, never from the AI's guesswork; a sentence with a number GOAT can't back is left out.
- One reference everywhere: SMART, the overlay and the Engineer Dashboard use the same reference lap; a saved session best gives way to a faster clean lap today, a Virtual Best still wins.
- Quiet where it matters: SMART says nothing on its own from about 150 m before your braking point to the corner exit, or in the last sector of a qualifying lap; held calls come on the exit. Safety calls and answers to your questions are never held.
- Brake cues from your own braking point (your last three laps), moving towards the reference a few metres a lap.
- Corners named one way: a corner's own name when it has one, otherwise its number, the same everywhere SMART speaks.
- Silent / Essentials / Full: choose how much SMART talks, on the LEVEL row of the SMART panel or by voice ("SMART, silent", "essentials", "full coaching"). Essentials is the default; safety calls are never muted.
- One correction a lap: at Essentials SMART gives at most one driving correction per lap, said away from the braking zones.
- Setup verdicts: after a change SMART wrote (Assetto Corsa) or a brake bias move, SMART judges it on your lap times and tells you to keep it or offers to put it back; going back is always your call. iRacing Garage changes come in a later build.
- Setup memory: SMART remembers setup changes on this car and track from earlier sessions and doesn't offer again a change you reverted here, unless the track is at least 8 C hotter or colder.
- Assetto Corsa: say "yes" to a SMART setup offer and GOAT saves the change as a new setup, "<your setup> GOAT v1" (your own file is untouched); load it from the setup screen at your next pit stop. ACC says it can't write it.
- Cloud backup is part of Coach and up; the phone companion app stays free for everyone.

Also in this build (from 0.9.225)
- Corner Debrief is back: its button sits next to Classic again in Telemetry, and GOAT reopens it if it was your last choice.
- A greyed real track box now says why when an Assetto Corsa or ACC track has no satellite imagery.
- Every video in one place: OBS's full session recordings now go to the Full recordings subfolder of your clip folder.
- SMART stays on your topics: with Coach CUSTOM and Conversation on, SMART's own remarks stay on the topics you ticked.
- SMART remembers earlier sessions on the same car and track (each day's best, your best ever, today against last time) and names the saved reference lap's date.
- No out-lap bests: SMART no longer quotes an out-lap as a best or coaches on an out-lap or recovery lap; a late "Brake." cue is dropped once you're past the braking point.
- Engineer Dashboard: the radio card shows only what SMART said, a lap after a pause is no longer merged with the next, the page follows your PC's language, and the Full screen / Other device buttons are never covered.
- GOAT Dash: the delta tile names its reference (Session best, Virtual best, Lap N), "personal best" only when it beats your reference, and your dot shows on the map with no field.
